If Conditions:
State is Armed
Calibration valid (still + upright)
Safety lock disengaged
Release height measured and entered
Release is a true drop from rest (not a throw)
Throttle cap raised for the real drop (boot default 15% would prevent braking)
Thrust-to-weight high enough to brake (code refuses below ~0.5 m/s2 spare braking acceleration)
ENTRY CASE B: same routine also runs at the end of a hop if landing brake is enabled (state Descending)
Initial Input Metrics:
Release height [m] (default 6.096 = 20 ft; MEASURE it)
Descent preset: ROBUST (default) or GENTLE
Throttle cap [%]
Payload weight [kg] (changes mass and braking margin)
Macrostate Sequence: Armed -> Await Release -> Descending (free fall) -> Landing (braking) -> Amp Down -> Rest
Key Setpoints / Behavior:
Free fall detected at |specific force| < 0.35 g for 0.04 s
Optional 0.1 s motors-off zero-g check, then idle spin
Height and speed dead-reckoned from release height
Brake along a speed-vs-height curve built from available thrust and thrust lag
Attitude held upright by the gimbal
Motors cut on touchdown
Success Criteria:
Touchdown speed <= TBD (team to set). Sim: ROBUST ~0.4-2 m/s, up to ~5 m/s if thrust lag is slow; GENTLE ~0.2 m/s but fails if motors shift the accelerometer
Upright at touchdown (tilt < TBD deg)
No Fault; ends in Rest
Verify with log (estimated speed, peak impact g) AND video: IMU-only speed drifts
Abort / Fallback:
Kill at any time -> Fault
Not enough thrust to brake -> Fault (does not try)
Tilt > 50 deg while braking -> thrust cut
Powered-time limit (ROBUST 5 s, GENTLE 12 s) -> motors cut
Mission time limit 25 s
Data to Log: Estimated height and vertical speed, specific force, commanded throttle, tilt, state, stored vs in-flight zero-g offset (to add)
Status in Code: Implemented v2 ('descent'). Macrostates Await Release > Descending > Landing > Amp Down > Rest. Payload input ('payload'). Feasibility now uses thrust AT THE THROTTLE CAP and is checked when 'descent' is typed (v1 checked only after release, at 100 % thrust). Zero-g offset vs stored calibration printed in the summary. Sim-tested (planar).

If Conditions:
State is Armed (arrive from Rest via Arm)
Drone at rest on level ground
Calibration valid
Safety lock disengaged
Thrust-to-weight x cos(lean + 10 deg) >= 1.15 using the payload weight entered
Throttle cap raised for the hop
Clear area downrange AND for roll-out after touchdown
Initial Input Metrics:
Distance [ft] (default 5; max TBD; v2 sim: 2-8 ft at TWR 1.3-1.85)
Bearing [deg clockwise from drone forward at start; 0 = forward, +90 = right]. No compass: east/west not available
Payload weight [kg] (CDR table: 0.454 kg inside a 2.144 kg total, so base drone = 1.690 kg)
Lean angle [deg] (default 15 in v2, was 25; must be <= gimbal limit)
Landing mode: ballistic (default) or brake
Range scale (default 1.0; tuned from tests)
Macrostate Sequence: Armed -> Launch (settle, tip) -> Amp Up -> Ascending (burn, cut, coast) -> Descending -> [Landing if brake] -> Amp Down -> Rest
Key Setpoints / Behavior:
Settle 0.4 s, zero position estimate, store heading
Tip: low thrust (~5 N, below weight), whole drone leaned to the lean angle toward the bearing
Burn: full thrust (cap), lean held, steer against predicted sideways miss
Cut when predicted landing distance >= distance / range scale (thrust tail included)
Coast with pod held 0.5 s, then gimbal centered
Success Criteria:
First touchdown within +/-1 ft of target (stretch +/-0.5 ft). TEAM TO CONFIRM which point counts: first touchdown or final rest after rolling
Sim: ~3.5 m/s horizontal speed at touchdown, so roll-out is large and NOT controlled
No Fault; ends in Rest
Abort / Fallback:
Not at rest after 3 s -> Armed (fault)
Not feasible -> Armed (fault)
Tip not reached in 1.5 s -> Amp Down
No liftoff within 0.8 s burn -> cut, Amp Down
Kill / mission time limit 25 s -> Fault
Data to Log: Estimated position and velocity, lean angle, throttle, predicted landing distance and sideways miss at cut, burn time. Measure real landing point with a tape
Status in Code: Implemented v2 ('hop <ft> [bearing] [lean=] [land=] [scale=]'). Liftoff and apex transitions, payload input, wait-for-rest (Amp Down), tilt guard, cap-aware feasibility. Default lean changed 25 -> 15 deg (see README). Sim-tested planar 2-8 ft. Yaw and sideways axes untested

If Conditions:
Same as Launch Horizontal Distance
Landing brake required for anything but a very low hop: impact speed ~ sqrt(2 g h) is about 4.4 m/s from 1 m and 6.3 m/s from 2 m
Initial Input Metrics:
Height [ft] (max TBD)
Payload weight [kg]
Landing mode: brake (default)
Throttle cap [%]
Macrostate Sequence: Armed -> Launch (settle only, no tip) -> Amp Up -> Ascending (burn, cut, coast) -> Descending -> Landing (brake) -> Amp Down -> Rest
Key Setpoints / Behavior:
Lean target 0 deg, attitude loop active from the first moment rotors spin (axial thrust above ~4.4 N makes the upright round base unstable)
Burn until PREDICTED apex height >= target (thrust tail included)
Hand over to Controlled Landing (entry case B) using the current height and speed estimate
Success Criteria:
Apex within +/-TBD of target (needs video or a rangefinder to verify; dead-reckoned height is only trusted over ~1 s)
Touchdown speed <= TBD, upright
No Fault; ends in Rest
Abort / Fallback:
Same as Launch Horizontal Distance
Tilt > 50 deg -> thrust cut
Data to Log: Estimated height, vertical speed, predicted apex at cut, throttle, tilt
Status in Code: Implemented v2 ('vhop <ft> [land=]', VHopController): upright burn with attitude loop from spin-up, apex predictor with thrust tail, hand-off to Controlled Landing at apex. Max height parameter 1.0 m (TBD). Sim-tested planar 0.15-1.0 m

If Conditions:
State is Rest (disarmed)
Drone still and upright for 2 s
Initial Input Metrics: None (pre-test six-position calibration with stored values: TO ADD)
Key Setpoints / Behavior: Average accelerometer and gyro for 2 s, set gravity direction and gyro bias
Success Criteria:
Mean |accel| within 1 m/s2 of 9.81
Tilt < 10 deg
Gyro quiet
Abort / Fallback: Warnings printed; do not arm if tilt or noise warnings appear
Status in Code: Implemented v2: 'cal' now blocks arming on failure; 'cal6' six-position accel calibration (least-squares fit, stored in flash)

If Conditions:
Arm: calibration valid, safety lock released, battery OK (if monitored)
Disarm and Kill: any state
Macrostate Sequence: Rest <-> Armed; Kill: any state -> Fault
Key Setpoints / Behavior:
Arm leaves motors at ESC minimum
Kill ('k') sets motors to minimum and centers gimbal immediately
Success Criteria:
Outputs safe after Kill
Armed state shown in status
Status in Code: Implemented v2: software safety lock ('unlock', re-engages at Rest/Fault); optional hardware lock pin and battery pin (disabled until wired). Kill -> Fault; 'disarm' Fault -> Rest; missions auto-return to Rest

If Conditions:
State is Armed, no mission running
Props removed or guarded
Initial Input Metrics: Pod tilt x and y [deg] (clamped to tilt limit)
Key Setpoints / Behavior: Moves the pod; no motors. Use to set servo signs, us-per-degree, and travel limits without binding
Success Criteria:
Pod moves the expected direction and amount
No binding at the limits

If Conditions:
State is Armed, no mission running
Drone restrained, props removed or guarded
Throttle cap set deliberately
Key Setpoints / Behavior: 1 s baseline with motors off, then spin; reports the shift in accelerometer magnitude caused by the motors
Success Criteria: Shift reported at several throttle levels. Shift near zero -> GENTLE preset may be considered; otherwise stay on ROBUST or add a rangefinder
Data to Log: Baseline and spinning mean/std of |specific force|
Status in Code: Implemented ('spin'); now also reports baseline std and a ROBUST/GENTLE hint

Routine: Routine = what an operator asks for (with inputs). Macrostates = where the flight is. Controllers = how setpoints are held. A routine checks conditions, runs a sequence of macrostates, and watches for success or abort.
TBD = must be measured or decided by the team. TO ADD = described here but not yet in the code. Numbers are current code defaults.
